about.me: AdaSouls builds the infrastructure that lets AI agents hold identity and reputation, manage wallets and make payments across any financial rail, without custody of funds or private keys.
about.server: Block producer and relays hosted in Europe, running the latest cardano-node.
about.company: AdaSouls develops ALMA, an open protocol for agent identity and verifiable reputation, and operates the SOULS stake pool on Cardano, formerly Falcon Cardano Stakepool (FALCO), running since 2020.
